newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - steady to 0.10 cent higher. Discount of December contract to cash supportive. Tight supply of choice deliverable-quality cattle should support October.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to 0.10 cent higher. Should follow direction in live cattle. CBOT corn called 1/2 to one cent higher, which may limit gains.
LIVE HOGS - 0.20 to 0.50 cent lower. Follow-through selling likely from Tuesday's limit declines. USDA cold storage report showed increase in total pork supplies.
PORK BELLIES - 0.50 to 0.75 cent lower. Follow-through selling likely from Tuesday's lower close. Cold storage report neutral for bellies.
